Meta.title: Add Equipment Tiers
Meta.author: OmegaPlatinum
Meta.description:
Adds high grade (HG) tiers to equipment based on the player's luck stat. プレイヤーの運ステータスに基づいて、装備品にハイグレード（HG）ティアを追加します。
[h1] Features [/h1] [list] [*] Applies high grade (HG) tiers to equipment at creation using the player's current luck. [*] Does not affect equipment that already has a tier level. [*] Increases certain traits such as Strength, Endurance, or Dexterity by 1.8x, 4x, or 6x depending on the HG tier. [/list]
[h1] Compatibility [/h1] This mod works with existing save files.
[img] https://img.shields.io/badge/Supports%20Game%20Version-EA%2023.267%20Stable-green [/img]
[h1] 特徴 [/h1] [list] [*] プレイヤーの運ステータスに応じて、装備品作成時にハイグレード（HG）ティアを適用します。 [*] すでにティアレベルを持つ装備品には影響しません。 [*] 力・耐久・器用さなどの一部特性が、HGティアに応じて約1.8倍、4倍、6倍に強化されます。 [/list]
[h1] 互換性 [/h1] このMODは既存のセーブデータと完全に互換性があります。
[img] https://img.shields.io/badge/対応ゲームバージョン-EA%2023.267%20Stable-green [/img]
